name: Sara Balloo's Plea
summary: In Ironforge, Sara Balloo grieves for Sully and asks you to carry her plea to King Magni Bronzebeard.

sections.title: A Widow's Request
sections.body: Sara has received Sully’s final letter, recovered from the waters of the Thandol Span. She wants the king to remember his sacrifice, so she writes him a plea. Grief keeps her from appearing before the throne herself. She entrusts the sealed letter to you, a champion of the Alliance, to carry to King Magni Bronzebeard.

sections.title: Audience with the King
sections.body: At the High Seat in Ironforge, King Magni Bronzebeard sets aside the affairs of state to read Sara’s private plea. He takes note of Khaz Modan’s brave defenders. His attention shows his bond with the common dwarves who built and defend his mountain kingdom.

faq.answer: Sara Balloo is a dwarf who lives in Ironforge. Her husband, the soldier Sully Balloo, died in the Thandol Span tragedy, and she holds his memory dear.

faq.q: Why does Sara want me to see the King instead of going herself?
faq.answer: Sara is overcome by grief after learning what happened to Sully. She feels unable to keep the composure expected when petitioning King Magni Bronzebeard at the High Seat.
Sully Balloo was a dwarf soldier who defended the Thandol Span. He died fighting along the bridge, leaving a waterlogged letter for his wife.

faq.q: Where do I deliver Sara Balloo's Plea?
faq.answer: You deliver Sara’s plea to King Magni Bronzebeard at the High Seat in the center of Ironforge.

faq.q: What happens after King Magni reads the plea?
faq.answer: After reading Sara’s plea, King Magni honors Sully Balloo, leading to A King's Tribute and the making of a lasting monument.

faq.q: What faction can undertake this task?
faq.answer: Only members of the Alliance can carry Sara’s plea, which concerns dwarven affairs and an audience with King Magni Bronzebeard.

angles.text: As a dwarf, carrying a grieving widow’s plea to your King touches on the importance your people place on stonework, lineage, and honoring ancestral sacrifice.
As a member of the Alliance, you carry word between grieving citizens and Alliance leaders. You bear witness to the personal cost of preserving the realm.
